projects.title: Edict Digital — General
projects.subtitle: Across all Edict Digital products
bullets: Configured project-wide engineering standards across every Edict Digital product, including GitHub Actions CI/CD, ESLint, Prettier, Husky, Jest, and React Testing Library.
Created reusable custom React hooks and shared utilities to separate business logic from UI components and reduce duplication.
Applied AI-assisted development with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, and GitHub Copilot for implementation, testing, refactoring, and technical analysis.
Delivered responsive, accessible frontend features using React.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, HTML5, CSS3/SCSS, Next.js, and SSR.
Implemented secure AWS S3 file-upload flows with presigned URLs and contributed to performance, code-quality, and maintainability improvements.

projects.title: Kastamonu Entegre – LIKE Admin Panel
projects.subtitle: Client Project
bullets: Built responsive, user-friendly interfaces from Figma designs with Kendo UI.
Refactored and optimized legacy modules — improved readability/maintainability and cut load/render time on affected screens by ~20–30%.
Introduced TanStack Query as the data layer for caching and request deduplication; managed client state with Jotai.
Implemented authorization and secure authentication using HttpOnly, Secure JWT cookies, with input validation and protection against common OWASP vulnerabilities.
Owned the 3-stage Order module (Draft, Quote, Order) with real-time order locking via SignalR to prevent concurrent edits.
Integrated AWS secure multi-part file upload flows with presigned URLs and fallback cleanup logic, enabling smooth transfer of large assets up to 1GB.
Optimized Webpack builds with code splitting and bundle size reduction.
Used AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini) with team rules and small, scoped prompts; reviewed every diff for correct APIs, types and edge cases and validated changes with Jest and manual QA.
Practiced structured agent review: small scoped prompts, checked TanStack Query usage and form/state logic, and rejected unsafe or over-scoped agent changes before CI/CD deploys.
Designed a Claude Code-based AI development team for the project, assigning dedicated Architect, Developer, Tester, and Planner agents, each with a distinct role and responsibility.

projects.title: Turkcell TLIFE – Avantajlar Dünyası Module
projects.subtitle: Client Project
bullets: Built dynamic, responsive interfaces with Blazor, jQuery and vanilla JavaScript, loading data asynchronously via AJAX.
Developed the Category and Tags modules, enabling structured content organization and filtering.
Developed the Campaign module and visualized campaign-related data in dashboard charts.

projects.title: COST – Admin Panel
projects.subtitle: Project
bullets: Developed responsive, user-friendly admin panel interfaces from Figma designs using React.js, Vite, TypeScript, React Router Dom, Tailwind CSS, and SCSS.
Introduced TanStack Query as the data layer for caching and request deduplication; managed client state with Redux Toolkit; managed client form state with React Hook Form.

Built a PDF generation and export workflow from scratch using React PDF Renderer, enabling users to preview and download offer documents populated with API-fetched data on the frontend, replacing the previous backend-generated PDF process.
Designed and developed dynamic, data-driven forms that render frontend components based on backend configurations retrieved from PostgreSQL, eliminating the need for hardcoded form structures.

Established a comprehensive authentication and authorization system using JWT, featuring access and refresh token mechanisms, protected routes, role-based access control (RBAC), and granular permission management.
Automated end-to-end CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions and an Ubuntu VPS, streamlining application builds, deployments, and production releases.
Improved Core Web Vitals with memoization, code splitting and lazy loading.
Contributed to backend development using Java, Spring Boot, and REST APIs, working on API design, request validation, error handling, testing, and service integration alongside frontend development.

projects.title: Karina – WEB
projects.subtitle: Project
bullets: Developed responsive, user-friendly interfaces using Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion and SCSS.
Implemented SEO meta tags and connected all site content to backend REST APIs with TanStack Query.
Used Next.js SSR / SSG / ISR on 10+ public pages for SEO and faster first load.
Optimized Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, and INP) by identifying and resolving performance issues using Chrome DevTools and Google Lighthouse.
Customized and integrated a Leaflet map into the project, adapting its markers, styling and interaction behavior to the product requirements.
Set up CI/CD (GitHub Actions) and production deploys for the product.

Implemented new features and fixed UI issues in the Helpdesk Admin Panel
